unreleased: Add a table_reservations module (app/modules/table_reservations) for the pub: guests reserve a table for a number of people (the system assigns the smallest free table that seats them; the default stay is 2 hours, the guest may ask for another, and it ends at closing time at the latest) or the whole pub from a chosen time until closing, with no sign-in needed. Between two reservations of one table there must be at least 30 minutes; the whole pub cannot be reserved over any table reservation nor twice in a day, and no table can be reserved while the whole pub is. Opening hours are set per weekday and can be changed once for a single date (closed with a reason visitors see, or other hours); a day with reservations cannot be closed or shortened until the administrator has cancelled each of them one by one, with a message for the guest that goes out in an e-mail (written in the guest's language; a failed e-mail is reported and never undoes the cancellation). Everything that decides on the existing reservations holds one advisory lock, so simultaneous requests cannot slip past each other. Guests get a confirmation with a cancellation link (a button on a page, never a GET) and the pub a notice (BOOKING_NOTIFY_MAIL, else CONTACT_MAIL); a honeypot field and a limit of upcoming reservations per e-mail address slow spam down (there is no rate limiting). Reservations, with the personal data in them, are deleted a configurable number of months after their day (default 12). Texts and limits are in backend/modules/table_reservations.json
